Plugin Studio troubleshooting and FAQ

What each message means and what to do — render errors, empty or missing datasets, masked values, pending datasets, imports that drop something, apps that stop, scripts that cannot connect, SATOM Builder messages — plus the questions people ask first.

👤 ForAdministratorAdvanced user
🔑 Permissionsstudio.plugin_studio studio.script_library

Views and widgets#

"Plugin render error: UndefinedError: 'x' is undefined"#

Possible causes - The body names a dataset it did not declare, or misspells a key. - An optional input or field is read without a default.

Solution 1. Tick the dataset in Datasets, or fix the name (server_policies_full, not server_policy_full). 2. Write {{ params.x | default("") }} for something optional.

Verification - Live preview renders without the red card.

"Plugin render error: UndefinedError: 'dict object' has no attribute 'y'"#

Possible causes - A column that does not exist in that dataset (p.name in server_policies_full, whose column is policy).

Solution 1. Check the dataset's columns in Datasets or in SATOM Builder's Library, and use the exact name.

"Plugin render error: UndefinedError: No first item, sequence was empty."#

Possible causes - | first or | last on an empty list.

Solution 1. Keep the list and test it: {% set m = rows | selectattr(...) | list %} then {{ m[0].x if m else "" }}.

"Plugin render error: SecurityError: access to attribute 'append' of 'list' object is unsafe."#

Possible causes - The sandbox is immutable: append, update, pop… are refused.

Solution 1. Build lists with filters (selectattr, map), or with namespace: {% set ns = namespace(rows=[]) %}{% set ns.rows = ns.rows + [x] %}.

"Cannot publish — the view still has a render error: …"#

Solution 1. Fix the error shown, Save, check the preview, publish again. SATOM renders the saved body at publish time, with your data.

The view is empty#

Possible causes - No device of this ADOM has data for the dataset yet (a new device, a product never synced). - The filter compares text with a number: built-in datasets give "7", device-object datasets 7. - The viewer may not see the devices (another ADOM, maintenance).

Solution 1. Show the count first: {{ server_policies_full.rows | length }}. 2. Compare like with like: params.device with built-in datasets, params.device | int with device-object datasets.

Every policy appears twice#

Possible causes - An administrator dataset reads a cache projection without the device_objects.layer = config filter (the cache keeps one row per layer). Built-in datasets read the config layer only since 4.3.0.

Solution 1. Ask the administrator to add the join and filter — see Build a plugin dataset.

A value reads ********#

Possible causes - The field's name says secret (password, passwd, psk, secret, token, private, ends in key): device-object datasets mask it. This is on purpose: no plugin reads credentials.

Datasets#

A dataset I need is not in the list#

Possible causes - A device-object type exists only once a device of that product has been synced, and the list follows the ADOM you are in (FortiGate objects in the FortiGate ADOM or Global). - An administrator dataset is still a draft, pending approval, or limited to another ADOM.

Solution 1. Switch to the product's ADOM, or sync the device. 2. Ask an administrator to publish it, or to build one. New object types appear within five minutes.

"datasets this server does not have were dropped: …"#

Possible causes - The package's view reads a device-object dataset this server has no device for, or an administrator dataset it neither has nor carries.

Solution 1. Sync a device of that product, or create the administrator dataset, then edit the view and tick it again.

"dataset … comes with the package: it lands pending until an administrator publishes it"#

Solution 1. An administrator opens Administrator → System → Database → Plugin datasets, reviews the pending dataset and publishes it. Until then the view renders with no rows from it.

"dataset definitions this server refused (the view does not get them): …"#

Possible causes - The carried query does not compile on this server (a table or column it does not have, or one that is sensitive here).

Solution 1. Build the dataset on this server with its own tables, then tick it in the view.

Apps and scripts#

An app run stops at a step with "… is undefined"#

Solution 1. Use {{ x | default('') }} for optional values, and check the name saved by the earlier step (Save the result as).

"connection … has no secret yet: set it in Plugin Studio › Connections"#

Solution 1. Open the connection on this server and type its secret. Packages never carry secrets.

A script cannot reach a URL#

Possible causes - Scripts run with network None by default.

Solution 1. Prefer a connection: connection("id") reaches its base URL whatever the network setting, with the credential SATOM holds. 2. Otherwise set Network to egress (not allowed for a script that travels in an app package).

SATOM Builder#

"… runs a SATOM that does not send its data to the Builder yet: it needs SATOM 4.3.0 or later."#

Solution 1. Upgrade the target SATOM, or Generate synthetic test data meanwhile.

The Builder lists only nine datasets#

Possible causes - The target SATOM is older than 4.3.0, or the library is cached from before.

Solution 1. Click Refresh from SATOM in the Datasets tab or the Library.

"Your SATOM token is invalid or lacks scope … (the token's owner must be allowed to author in Plugin Studio)."#

Solution 1. Give the token's owner studio.script_library, or use a token of an author who has it.

FAQ#

Can a plugin run SQL? No. A view declares datasets; an administrator who needs a new query builds a plugin dataset with the no-SQL builder. Apps may query an external PostgreSQL through a connection, never SATOM's database.

Can a plugin change a device? A view never. An app only through the SATOM steps built for it (issue a certificate, create or remove a FortiWeb server policy) and its actions only raise a draft change request.

Who sees my view? Everyone signed in to its ADOM once it is published; each sees only their own devices' rows.

Does a view slow SATOM down? Every dataset is read at each render, for that viewer. Declare only what you use; let an administrator total on the server.

Where do I start? Start here, then Your first view.
